subscribe.title: Subscribe to the calendar
subscribe.intro: Put game release dates in your own calendar. Subscribe once and delays, cancellations and date changes show up in the same calendar automatically, with nothing to re-import.

delay.title: Updates take time
delay.body: Our data updates right away, but calendar apps only check for new content now and then: Google Calendar and Outlook can take hours up to a day to show a change, and Apple Calendar follows the refresh rate you choose. Treat this as a release-date reminder, not a live notification.

releases.description: Release dates for the next 90 days, picking the most-watched games by popularity. One all-day entry per game and platform.

platform.title: One platform
platform.description: Only the release dates for a single platform, covering all its games in the next 90 days.

clients.title: How to subscribe in each calendar

apple.title: Apple Calendar (iPhone, iPad, Mac)
apple.s1: Use “Open in calendar app” above. Or in Calendar on Mac choose File → New Calendar Subscription; on iPhone go to Settings → Calendar → Accounts → Add Account → Other → Add Subscribed Calendar.
apple.s2: Paste the subscription URL and choose Subscribe.
apple.s3: You can change the refresh frequency in the subscription settings.

google.title: Google Calendar
google.s1: Open Google Calendar on the web from a computer.
google.s2: Next to “Other calendars” on the left, click “+” and choose “From URL”.
google.s3: Paste the subscription URL and click “Add calendar”.
google.note: The mobile app cannot add a calendar from a URL; once you add it on the web, the app on your phone shows it too, on the same Google account. Google refreshes subscriptions at irregular intervals, usually hours up to a day, and there is no manual refresh.

outlook.title: Outlook
outlook.s1: On the web: open Calendar and choose Add calendar → Subscribe from web.
outlook.s2: Paste the subscription URL, give it a name and import.
outlook.s3: Outlook decides the refresh interval, usually a few hours.

realtime.title: Want instant alerts?
realtime.body: Calendar subscriptions are not instant. We plan to offer email and Discord direct-message alerts later, so you hear about a delay right away.
